The duties and responsibilities for a IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC) GS-2210-13 generally include, but are not limited to, the following: Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, reliability, resiliency, operational readiness, and service dependencies; resolve complex operational issues.

Coordinate with budget, acquisition, contracting, program, and technical personnel to ensure effective management of IT resources. Develop network project plans, technical requirements, implementation strategies, schedules, milestones, and resource requirements.

Provide technical recommendations to contracting officials regarding contract administration, modifications, deliverable acceptance, schedule changes, and performance issues. Lead cross-functional teams of technical staff, program officials, contractors, vendors, and internal/external stakeholders.
To qualify for the position of IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC), at GS-2210-13, you must meet the basic qualification requirements listed below. Basic Qualifications (2210 series): Please refer to the OPM IT Management Series 2210 Qualification Standard for the specific experience requirements for the GS-12 and above positions.

AND Specialized Experience: To qualify for the GS-13 grade level, you must have one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service, or comparable non-Federal experience.

Specialized experience is defined as experience performing the following duties: Participate in the planning execution and monitoring enterprise IT projects involving network services, information security, and/or telecommunications. You MUST meet all qualification requirements by the 09/04/2026 of this announcement.

Your resume must support your responses to the application questionnaire and the qualification requirements. Failure to do so may result in an ineligible rating. See the Required Documents section for important notes about what must be included in your resume.

After you submit this application, you will receive an e-mail informing you that a USA Hire assessment is required of you. You will have 48 hours from the closing date of this announcement 09/04/2026 to complete the assessment as this assessment is part of your application.

The position serves as a Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist for all BARD patron-facing products in the Patron Engagement Section (PES), Patron and Network Engagement Division, National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS), Library Collections and Services Group.

As the Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist, you will: Serve as the subject matter expert in the development, implementation, and distribution of all versions of the product.

Review and analyze all BARD patron-facing products to ensure continuity in operation, consistency in delivery, high-level of accessibility, and that all patron considerations have been met. Coordinate all patron-facing customer service and technical support for all BARD products.

This includes BARD on the web, BARD Mobile for iOS, BARD Mobile for Android, BARD Mobile for Fire Devices, BARD Express, Digital Advanced (DA2) Talking Book machine, and the My Talking Book Skill. Serve as the primary liaison between the various BARD initiatives, NLS patrons, and other NLS stakeholders. Perform other duties as assigned.

The position description number for this position is 467973. The salary range indicated reflects the locality pay adjustments for the Washington, D.C., Metropolitan area. The incumbent of this position will work a Flexitime work schedule. This is a non-supervisory, non-bargaining unit position.

Relocation expenses will not be authorized for the person(s) selected under this vacancy announcement.
Applicants must have had progressively responsible experience and training sufficient in scope and quality to furnish them with an acceptable level of the following knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position without more than normal supervision.

Ability to interact collaboratively, providing consultation and liaison services.** Ability to provide customer service planning and management work for a program. ** Ability to communicate in writing. Ability to utilize applicable information technology. Ability to communicate effectively other than in writing.

Serves as the Aquatics Program Manager responsible for the daily operation and supervision of aquatic fitness, training and recreational programs, personnel, and classes at aquatic facilities. Manages multiple indoors and outdoors pools.
Provides overall supervision of the aquatic programs. Establishes and reviews the Aquatic programs. Establishes and reviews the Aquatic Risk Management plan for all aquatic facilities.
Coordinates with the MWR marketing department to publicize aquatic events. Establishes and executes processes to evaluate the effectiveness of the aquatic programs. Responsible for APF and NAF budget for assigned facilities and programs.
Develops and updates the Standard Operating Procedures for the aquatic facilities, programs and enforces policies. Interviews and selects such staff and provides them with required orientation, training and management to meet all activity needs.

Resumes must be two pages (or less). Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position. A qualified candidate must possess the following: Possesses demonstrated experience in planning, administering and executing aquatic programs.

This experience may have been gained managing indoor or outdoor aquatic programs and facilities. Required experience must have been equivalent to the next lower grade level. An undergraduate or graduate degree in related fields such as physical education or kinesiology may be substituted for six (6) months of the required work experience.

If using education in place of experience, transcripts must be uploaded at the time of application.

Possesses and maintains the following certifications: -American Red Cross Lifeguarding and First Aid -CPR for the Professional Rescuer/AED -Lifeguard Instructor (Red Cross) -Water Safety Instructor (Red Cross) -Aquatic Facilities Operator (AFO) or Certified Pool Operator (COP) certification In addition, for facilities that use Oxygen Administration & 02 bottles; the Oxygen Administration & 02 Administration certification (Red Cross or installation offered training) must be obtained within two weeks of reporting for duty.

In addition to the above qualifications, candidates who possess the following qualifications will be considered "Highly Preferred" or "Best Qualified": -Lifeguard Instructor Trainer (Red Cross) -Water Safety Instructor (Red Cross) -Equipment (Safe Operations and Basic Maintenance Repairs) -Nationally Recognized Basic Fitness Trainer Certification or Aquatic Exercise Association Instructor -Adapted Aquatics Instructor -SCUBA Diving Instructor (PADI, NAUI, YMCA or equivalent) Applicants who meet the Minimum qualifications, & Highly Preferred Criteria will be referred to management for consideration first.

All others may be referred if management does not make a selection from the Highly Preferred list.

Worum es bei uns gerade geht
Projektmanagement im Online-Marketing bedeutet bei uns nicht, Tickets zu verwalten. Es bedeutet, Kundenbeziehungen zu führen, Kanalentscheidungen mitzugestalten und ein Team aus Spezialist:innen zusammenzuhalten.
KI verändert gerade, wie wir arbeiten und was Kund:innen erwarten. Wir suchen jemanden, der das als Chance begreift und beides kann: strategisch denken und hands-on umsetzen.
Aufgaben
Was du bei uns machst
Du führst die Kundenbeziehung: Ziele und Roadmaps werden gemeinsam mit Kund:innen definiert, Kick-offs, Quartals-Reviews und Jour Fixes liegen bei dir
Du verbindest Stakeholder auf Kundenseite und intern, hältst Kontakt zu Geschäftsführung, Fachbereichen, Marketing, Sales und IT und bringst alle an einen Tisch
Du entwirfst Strategien, triffst Kanalmix-Entscheidungen (SEO/GEO, SEA, Social, Tracking) und identifizierst Wachstumshebel
Du nutzt KI aktiv im Alltag: für Recherche, Analysen, Content-Entwürfe, Automationen.
Du verantwortest Performance und Reporting, erstellst Reports mit klaren Empfehlungen und nächsten Schritten statt reinen Datenlisten
Du packst auch selbst mit an und setzt Maßnahmen in ausgewählten Projekten operativ um
Du gestaltest den PM-Fachbereich aktiv mit: Standards, Learnings, Methoden
Wie wir arbeiten
Wir denken Kanäle zusammen und nicht in Silos
KI ist fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeit, aber kein Selbstzweck
Wir haben keine Ellenbogenkultur. Wenn du etwas nicht kannst helfen dir dabei, es zu lernen
Entscheidungen treffen wir gemeinsam und transparent
Wie der Job konkret aussieht
Du arbeitest an mehreren Kundenprojekten gleichzeitig und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für deine Kund:innen
Du priorisierst deine Aufgaben eigenständig, vertrittst deine Einschätzungen gegenüber Kund:innen und koordinierst dein Team aus Spezialist:innen
Nicht jede Strategie funktioniert beim ersten Anlauf. Entscheidend ist der Umgang damit
Du arbeitest mit bestehenden Kundenbeziehungen und eingehenden Anfragen
Qualifikation
Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Projektmanagement, Account Management oder vergleichbar eigenverantwortlichen Tätigkeiten
Du willst Kundenbeziehungen führen, nicht abarbeiten. Geschäftsmodelle verstehen, Prioritäten gemeinsam setzen, Entscheidungen mittragen
Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Online-Marketing-Bereich (z.B. SEO/GEO, SEA, Social, Tracking) und die Motivation, die anderen Bereiche zu lernen
KI ist für dich ein Werkzeug, das du regelmäßig nutzt. Du weißt, wo sie trägt und wo nicht, und du bist neugierig auf das, was als nächstes kommt
Strukturiertes, eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten auch mit mehreren Projekten, Deadlines und Stakeholdern parallel
Deutschkenntnisse im Kompetenzniveau C1
Kurz gesagt: Du bist Ansprechperson, Strateg:in und Macher:in in einem.
Du erfüllst nicht jedes Kriterium? Kein Problem. Wenn du glaubst, die Position passt zu dir, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Partnerschaftliche Projekte mit Substanz, auf Augenhöhe mit Kund:innen und Freiraum für eigene Ideen
Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung inklusive interner und externer Weiterbildungen sowie Mentoring
Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze mit elektrisch höhenverstellbaren Steh-Sitz-Tischen und exzellente technische Ausstattung im Office sowie im Home Office

Job Details Under general direction of an Engineering Project Director, the Engineering Project Manager is responsible for one or more components of an overall project.

This role is suitable for an experienced Project Manager with an Engineering background (industrial Engineering is preferred). Projects relate to the design, build, and improvement of distribution facilities and processes. Assignments may span one or more projects that can range in size, complexity, and cross functional involvement.

Typical scope of management ranges from less than $1MM to greater than $20MM per project.

Works closely with Project Director to assist in the development of a project charter outlining project design and/or implementation requirements.
Assists in the preparation of capital expenditure requests for projects.
Manages assigned scope according to the project charter including vendor selection and vendor management from RFP through design, installation, and final invoicing.
Manages overall onsite build or installation coordination with internal and external partners.
Manages development and management of project budget
Project elements may include material handling equipment, warehouse, and business systems, building construction or modification and other equipment and services typically found within a distribution environment.
Assigned scope may include design, contractor coordination, testing, training, and start up activities.
May be assigned multiple areas of scope.

s.h: May be assigned overall responsibility for a project.
s.t:
Manages assigned team members in the execution of the assigned scope.
Manages and reports on project budget for assigned scope.
May issue or approve purchase orders according to company policy.
Develops, maintains, and reports on timelines for assigned scope.
Typically requires cross-functional coordination with other internal teams and vendors.
Generates timely and concise communication regarding project status and pending issues.
Supports in the development of supplier specifications and RFP’s, supports the contractual negotiations, and manages the execution of the plans outlined in the contracts.
Manages engagement with external consultants and other outsourced resources and vendors that perform work associated with the assigned project scope.
Coordinates activities with Project Director and other internal project teams to ensure alignment.
Willing to travel up to 50% of the time. Must be located near an airport.

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
Master’s Degree and/or PMP certification desired.

Experience managing automation or construction projects exceeding $5MM per project.
Experience leading cross-functional teams.
Experience planning and tracking projects using project management software.
Experience developing and tracking project costs. 7+ years of experience as a project manager, project engineer or related occupation.
Prior experience in consulting, Six-Sigma, Lean Manufacturing or Kaizen is beneficial.
Demonstrated knowledge, understanding and experience leading projects related to warehouse operations, warehouse design, warehouse and business systems, process improvement and standardization, engineered labor standards, and transportation.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing; ability to communicate (and work) effectively with people from different technical and business backgrounds, acting as a liaison, understanding and appreciating different perspectives and translating into terms necessary for any group or individual to understand.
Ability to lead dynamically and energize work teams to learn and apply new skills and techniques to respond to business needs
Good analytical, conceptual and problem solving skills to evaluate business problems and apply knowledge to identify appropriate solution

You will serve as a Program Manager in the Logistics and Requirements Department (N4/8), Office of the Commander at Naval Cyber Defense Operations Command.
You will develop detailed non-Manpower Program Memorandum Objective (POM) and related assessments via briefs, written papers, communications, and/or oral presentations.
You will gather, review, and direct contracting and integration timelines of new analytical technologies and techniques for improving methods, results, and procedures to meet emerging requirements, and ensures maximum productivity.
You will ensure IT expenditures, are properly prepared, routed, advocated, and approved in the IT Procurement System.
You will create business value through implementation of mission critical technology; strategic planning of command growth objectives; and ensures technology systems and procedures lead to outcomes in line with command goals.
You will oversee facilities and logistics, developing plans for appropriation and assignment of space, communication equipment, work stations and office/IT equipment to support command mission.
You will oversee contractors that support facilities management and maintenance.
You will collaborate with top management to negotiate, determine, schedule or coordinate supporting services.
You will assign work to subordinates based on priorities, difficulty of assignments, and the capabilities of employees.
Applicant must have directly applicable experience that demonstrates the possession of knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies necessary for immediate success in the position.

Qualifying experience may have been acquired in any public or private sector job, but will clearly demonstrate past experience in the application of the particular competencies or knowledge, skills and abilities necessary to successfully perform the duties of the position.

Such experience is typically in or directly related to the work of the position to be filled.

Qualifying experience would be demonstrated by: -Experience providing direction for the development of standard operating procedures and work flows. -Experience managing subordinate employees to include planning, evaluating, and establishing objectives, deadlines, and standards for acceptable levels of work. -Experience directing the analysis, evaluation and development of various facility and security assessments, forecasting required resources, and tools. -Experience analyzing all work efforts, identifying problem areas and determining feasible solutions for problem resolution.

s.h: Our mission: e liminating every barrier to mental health.
s.t:
Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.
Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.
As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.
Alma, a Spring Health Company, is on a mission to simplify access to high-quality, affordable mental health care. We do this by making it easy and financially rewarding for therapists to accept insurance and offer in-network care.

When a provider joins Alma, they gain access to a suite of tools that not only help them better run their business, but also grow it sustainably and develop as a provider. Alma is available in all 50 states, with over 20,000 therapists in our growing network. Anyone looking for a therapist can browse Alma’s free directory.

Alma has raised $220.5M in funding from Insight Partners, Optum Ventures, Tusk Venture Partners, Primary Venture Partners, First Round Capital, Sound Ventures, BoxGroup, Cigna Ventures, and Rainfall Ventures. Alma was also named one of Inc’s Best Workplaces in 2022 and 2023.
Candidate Interview Guide
Alma is looking for a Program Manager to join our Payer Success team within Operations. In this role, you'll be the central quarterback for our payer partnerships in steady-state operations – the person who holds the full picture across the end-to-end RCM lifecycle, from credentialing and rostering to claims adjudication to CX.

You won't be expected to solve every issue yourself, but you will be the one making sure nothing falls through the cracks: tracking open issues, mobilizing the right internal experts, and driving accountability across teams until problems are resolved.

You'll work closely across all teams at Alma, in particular within Operations and Business Development, to turn operational insights into action and improve outcomes across our payer portfolio. This is a full time, fully remote position on our team. Occasional travel may be required for team or company events/meetings.

Track open payer issues end-to-end, ensuring clear ownership, visibility, and accountability across cross-functional teams until resolution
Drive measurable business outcomes by improving RCM efficiency and effectiveness, with the ultimate goal of increasing revenue performance and delivering a better experience for Alma providers and their clients
Partner closely with internal operations teams to connect the dots across stakeholders, subteams, and workflows - surfacing interdependencies and ensuring issues move to resolution rather than stall
Serve as the primary operational point of contact for BD counterparts, triaging and coordinating new requirements surfaced by the payer and claims, roster, complaints, and escalation issues across assigned payers
Partner with the Business Development Team on payer calls to drive RCM discussions, align stakeholders, and move issues to resolution
Proactively monitor for new payer requirements and evolving payer mergers, and mobilize the right internal teams to implement changes before they become problems
Track and report on RCM performance by payer - surfacing trends, flagging risks, and ensuring the right teams are engaged to drive improvement

Portfolio RCM performance improvement (e.g., denial rate, reimbursement, AR days)
Portfolio payers meeting performance goals
On-time completion of payer initiatives/projects
Completion and maintenance of payer health assessments/business reviews
Stakeholder satisfaction (internal and payer partners)

Experienced in healthcare operations - you understand how insurance claims and payer relationships actually work
A strong cross-functional collaborator who can align people across teams without direct authority
Highly organized with a track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects from kickoff through launch
Comfortable in ambiguity - you can proactively identify what needs to happen next without waiting to be told
A clear communicator who can distill operational complexity for both internal partners and external payer contacts
Detail-oriented and data-driven, with the ability to monitor performance metrics and translate them into action

This position is being filled under DoD Modified Direct-Hire Auth (Certain DoD Personnel), PL 118-31, Sec 1250B(i)(2), 12/22/2023 As a IT PROJECT MANAGER at the GS-2210-13 some of your typical work assignments may include: Serving as Information Technology (IT) Project Manager (PM), center of expertise, lead government Point of Contact (POC), and Technical Representative for key IT projects.

Identifies and implements opportunities for improving project management efficiency and effectiveness. Responsible for implementing best practices to bring about the successful completion of JS specific Information Technology related project goals and objectives for assigned projects.

Ensure no changes to approved project schedules absent prior Government coordination and approval. Represents leadership to the JS, OSD, and external agencies.

Work with external agencies, services, and organizations, both government and commercial sector, to ensure the JS remains current with the state of commercial business technology practices while integrating the JS's IT requirements within DoD as well as Enterprise standards
You may qualify at the GS-13, if you fulfill the following qualifications: One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service: Overseeing and ensuring the achievement of all project goals and objectives while honoring the project constraints, which include project scope, time and budget Implementing best practices to bring about the successful completion of Information Technology related project goals and objectives for assigned projects; Guiding contracted enterprise solution efforts, including Technical Oversight, Schedule Management, Customer Coordination, reporting, and post-delivery assessment.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

In addition to meeting qualifications, your application package must reflect the applicable experience to meet the Individual Occupational Requirements for the 2210 series. https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/2200/information-technology-it-management-series-2210-alternative-a/ Experience must be IT related; the experience may be demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (for example, IT certification), as appropriate.

For all positions individuals must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Substitution of education may not be used in lieu of specialized experience for this grade level. All materials must be submitted by the closing date of the announcement.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction des soins incarne l-autorité en matière de soins. Elle a pour mission de garantir la qualité et la sécurité des soins au sein de l'établissement. A ce titre, la Direction des soins a droit de regard sur l-ensemble des activités des soins (infirmiers, infirmières et différents corps professionnels de santé).

Pour remplir sa mission, elle s-appuie sur trois pôles d'expertises : qualité, durabilité et innovation digitale ; expertise clinique et pratiques professionnelles ; management et transformation.
## Description du poste ##
La direction des soins est à la recherche de son ou sa future responsable diététicienne pour manager et accompagner les équipes sur le site de Cluse-Roseraie dans leurs prestations dans différents départements médicaux. La patientèle peut être adulte comme pédiatrique notamment dans le domaine des soins aigus ainsi que pour l-enseignement thérapeutique au décours de la maladie chronique.
Vous dirigez une équipe d-environ 30 collaborateurs et collaboratrices. Vous organisez, coordonnez et supervisez leurs activités et prévoyez toute action nécessaire de développement des compétences individuelles comme collectives. Vous garantissez une circulation optimale des informations, qu-elle soit ascendante, descendante et/ ou transversale. Vous développez un climat de confiance dans l-équipe nécessaire au bien vivre et travailler ensemble dans le respect des valeurs institutionnelles.
Vous savez donner le cap et accompagner vos équipes pour atteindre des objectifs communs. Vous déclinez les axes stratégiques de votre métier en objectifs réalisables par l-équipe tout en veillant à la contribution individuelle de chaque membre.
En qualité de responsable d-équipe, vous êtes garante ou garant de la qualité des soins nutritionnels et promouvez toute mesure visant à optimiser et à améliorer les prestations offertes à la patientèle. Vous disposez d-indicateurs pour conduire l-amélioration continue de la qualité. Vous contribuez également au développement de nouvelles pratiques.
Votre esprit collaboratif vous permet de soutenir et développer l-interdisciplinarité entre tous les professionnelles et professionnels de la santé agissant sur la prise en charge des patientes et patients.
Vous gérez aisément la bonne allocation des ressources comme du matériel pour répondre aux besoins en soins des patients et patientes dans le cadre du budget alloué. Vous exercez également un rôle de référente ou référent pour les systèmes tarifaires en lien avec la profession
Selon les besoins, vous êtes amené ou amenée à recruter de nouvelles collaboratrices et collaborateurs et veillez au développement de leur expertise dans les champs de spécialité de chaque secteur tout en veillant à la polyvalence nécessaire des compétences

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor HES en nutrition et diététique ou d'un titre jugé équivalent, reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse.
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée en management, acquise au travers d'au moins cinq années de pratique dans le domaine hospitalier. Une formation en management, telle qu'un CAS en management des institutions de santé, constitue un atout.
Dotée ou doté d'excellentes qualités relationnelles, vous faites preuve d'entregent et d'une communication positive. Vous savez fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et instaurer un climat de collaboration propice au bon fonctionnement du service.
Ouvert ou ouverte au changement, vous êtes capable d'accompagner les évolutions de votre environnement professionnel avec pragmatisme. Vous savez également prendre du recul sur vos pratiques managériales afin de les faire évoluer de manière continue.
Vous êtes une personne reconnue pour votre sens de l'organisation, votre flexibilité et votre capacité à gérer les priorités, vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement où les activités sont variées et transversales.
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants et possédez une excellente maîtrise de la langue française.

At Intuitive , we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.

We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture—our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real-world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.

## Description de l'emploi ##
L'Unité organisation territoriale (UOT) de la Direction générale de la cohésion sociale (DGCS), contribue à la réflexion et au pilotage de l'organisation des prestations sociales sur le territoire cantonal.

Elle analyse les besoins des différentes régions, coordonne les acteurs concernés et accompagne la mise en œuvre et l'évolution des dispositifs sociaux, en veillant à leur cohérence et à leur accessibilité pour la population.

Elle a également pour mission d'assurer une vision cohérente transverse pour le parc immobilier subventionné par la DGCS qui comprend notamment l'hébergement médico-social (EMS, EPSM, ESE) et les ateliers à vocation productive, soit environ 400 bâtiments gérés par 250 partenaires.
Afin de mener un projet ambitieux visant à établir une stratégie pour la mise aux normes énergétiques et d'adaptation aux conséquences du réchauffement climatique du parc immobilier de la structure socio-sanitaire, l'Unité organisation territoriale (UOT) recherche **un·e Chef·fe de projet Plan climat.**
Pour de plus amples informations, veuillez consulter le cahier des charges en cliquant ici ou contacter Monsieur Mathieu Capcarrère, Conseiller stratégique, à l'adresse email: dgcs.recrutement@vd.ch
## Responsabilités ##
* Structurer et mettre en place de la phase 1 du projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois de 2ème génération œuvrant à faire un état des lieux du parc immobilier accueillant des populations vulnérables et subventionné par la DGCS.
* Piloter la phase 1 du projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois (EMPD 24 LEG 168) et en assurer l-avancement selon le calendrier prévu et l-enveloppe budgétaire dédiée.
* Conseiller, renseigner et appuyer les mandataires externes, les interlocuteur·trice·s internes, et les partenaires impliqués dans le projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois.
* Initier et piloter la phase 2 du projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois en définissant et mettant en œuvre un ou plusieurs projets pilotes liés à la transition énergétique, à la durabilité et au climat, sur la base des résultats et analyses de la phase 1.
* Coconstruire les réflexions avec l-équipe UOT sur les questions de transition énergétique, durabilité et climat, et être activement partie prenante aux réflexions collectives de l-équipe et du service sur ces thématiques.

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for coordinating the successful delivery of customer projects and service engagements by aligning resource capacity with customer demand, driving project execution, and ensuring delivery commitments are met. This role serves as the operational hub between customers, delivery teams, project resources, and leadership to ensure projects are properly staffed, risks are proactively managed, and customer expectations are consistently achieved.
The Service Delivery Manager oversees project governance, resource planning, meeting facilitation, action item management, and escalation resolution while maintaining visibility into project health, resource utilization, timelines, budgets, and overall customer satisfaction.
You will lead end-to-end delivery of Palantir-based programs, ensuring alignment between stakeholders, timelines, and technical teams. Role Description
Resource Management & Capacity Planning
Maintain visibility into all available service delivery resources and project assignments.
Align inbound project demand with available resource capacity and skill sets.
Coordinate resource assignments across multiple customer engagements and projects.
Monitor resource utilization and recommend adjustments to optimize delivery performance.
Identify resource constraints and skill gaps and develop mitigation plans.
Partner with delivery leaders and functional managers on staffing priorities and future resource needs.
Project Delivery & Execution
Track all incoming projects and service engagements from initiation through completion.
Ensure projects are appropriately staffed and aligned to customer requirements.
Monitor project schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, and deliverables.
Facilitate project status meetings, delivery reviews, and customer update meetings.
Ensure projects remain on track and proactively address obstacles impacting delivery.
Support project teams in developing and executing recovery plans when necessary.
Governance & Accountability
Facilitate recurring project and operational review meetings.
Document meeting outcomes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.
Distribute meeting notes within established timelines.
Track action items through completion and hold stakeholders accountable for commitments.
Maintain project dashboards, status reports, risk logs, and delivery metrics.
Ensure consistent adherence to delivery processes and governance standards.
Risk & Escalation Management
Identify and manage project risks related to scope, budget, timeline, resources, and technical dependencies.
Maintain risk and issue logs for active projects.
Work with project teams to develop mitigation plans and corrective actions.
Serve as the primary escalation point for project delivery and resource-related issues.
Drive issue resolution while maintaining alignment among stakeholders.
Escalate significant risks and concerns to leadership when appropriate.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders and internal teams.
Provide clear communication regarding project status, risks, resource challenges, and delivery commitments.
Facilitate discussions to resolve competing priorities and delivery challenges.
Support customer satisfaction through proactive communication and successful execution.
Ensure customer expectations are aligned with project objectives and delivery capabilities.

**Aidez nos clients à prendre de meilleures décisions de transaction et à transformer les thèses transactionnelles en résultats mesurables**
Notre équipe suisse de premier plan en Transformation des Transactions et Intégration Post-Fusion conseille des clients suisses du secteur corporatif, du capital-investissement et du marché intermédiaire afin de générer et créer de la valeur tout au long du cycle de vie des fusions-acquisitions.

Nous aidons les clients à évaluer la performance opérationnelle avant la signature, à identifier et quantifier les opportunités de création de valeur, et à gérer les complexités des acquisitions, cessions et scissions.

Chez Deloitte, nous collaborons étroitement avec nos collègues des services transactionnels, des évaluations et de la finance d'entreprise pour garantir une approche fluide et axée sur la valeur des transactions.
**Comment vous ferez la différence**
Vous travaillerez avec des équipes de direction d-entreprises, des investisseurs en capital-investissement et des professionnels des fusions-acquisitions pour identifier et réaliser la valeur issue des transactions M&A. Vous aiderez à façonner la réflexion stratégique, à traiter les enjeux critiques de performance et à mobiliser l-ensemble des compétences de Deloitte pour maximiser la valeur des transactions.
En tant que membre d-une équipe dédiée de spécialistes M&A, vous fournirez des conseils en due diligence opérationnelle en reliant la performance financière, les capacités opérationnelles et l-ambition stratégique. Votre travail portera sur la croissance des revenus et la réduction des coûts à travers le coût des marchandises vendues (COGS) et les frais généraux, administratifs et commerciaux (SG&A), que ce soit par des opportunités d-amélioration autonome ou des synergies transactionnelles.
**Votre rôle et responsabilités**
* Diriger la livraison quotidienne des missions ou volets de création de valeur M&A et de due diligence pré-transaction, en collaborant avec les interlocuteurs clients sur le contenu, les conclusions et les priorités ;
* Diriger et travailler au sein d-équipes projets pour réaliser des due diligences, des analyses opérationnelles et des bases financières, et assurer la qualité des analyses et livrables produits ;
* Aider les clients corporatifs et en capital-investissement à comprendre les capacités opérationnelles des cibles potentielles et des sociétés du portefeuille existant ;
* Soutenir les clients corporatifs et en capital-investissement dans l-évaluation des synergies potentielles de fusion, l-impact et les complexités des scissions sur les organisations vendeuses et cibles, ainsi que le potentiel d-amélioration autonome des performances des rachats et cessions d-entreprises ;
* Structurer et conduire des entretiens clients pour identifier les complexités opérationnelles et les opportunités de création de valeur, impliquant souvent des parties prenantes senior à travers l-organisation ;
* Synthétiser rapidement des informations qualitatives et quantitatives issues de sources diverses en hypothèses de création de valeur claires, fondées sur des preuves, et en un récit convaincant que les clients peuvent facilement comprendre ;
* Appliquer une approche pragmatique 80/20 pour concentrer les livrables sur les enjeux les plus importants pour la transaction et la thèse d-investissement ;
* Fournir des conseils pratiques de création de valeur opérationnelle appuyés par des preuves issues d-entretiens, d-analyses de données, de bases financières et de benchmarks externes ;
* Gérer la portée, les priorités, les délais, les budgets, les risques et la qualité des missions, en collaboration étroite avec les associés, directeurs et managers seniors ;
* Construire des relations de confiance avec les dirigeants d-entreprise, les investisseurs en capital-investissement, les professionnels M&A et les responsables fonctionnels ;
* Soutenir le développement commercial par la préparation de propositions, présentations et documents clients, et contribuer au développement des relations clients ; et
* Identifier, concevoir et diriger des initiatives de développement de la pratique axées sur la création de valeur M&A et la due diligence pré-transaction.
**Ce que nous recherchons**
* Un diplôme de Bachelor ou Master en commerce, économie, finance, ingénierie ou autre discipline pertinente ;
* Au moins cinq ans d-expérience professionnelle pertinente en M&A, avec un accent particulier sur la due diligence commerciale ou opérationnelle au sein d-un cabinet Big Four, d-un cabinet de conseil en stratégie ou d-un conseiller spécialisé en restructuration et redressement ;
* Une expérience approfondie en due diligence opérationnelle, ainsi qu-en identification, suivi et réalisation de synergies ; diagnostics de séparation et calculs autonomes ; diagnostics de performance autonome ;
* Idéalement, une expérience démontrée également en due diligence commerciale, planification d-entreprise, revue de plans d-affaires et croissance des revenus ;
* Une connaissance démontrée des processus de due diligence et des exigences documentaires dans un environnement de conseil ;
* Une expérience et une connaissance dans une ou plusieurs des industries suivantes : Énergie, Ressources & Industriels ; Consommation ; Sciences de la vie & Santé ; ou Technologie, Médias & Télécommunications ;
* Excellentes compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de décomposer des enjeux complexes, d-identifier les causes profondes et de recommander des solutions actionnables ; et
* Une maîtrise professionnelle complète de l-anglais ; la maîtrise de l-allemand, idéalement incluant l-allemand suisse, est fortement souhaitée.
**Rejoindre notre équipe**
Vous ferez partie d-une équipe amicale, diversifiée et très motivée. Nous vous aiderons à vous développer tant personnellement que professionnellement grâce à l-apprentissage sur le terrain, au mentorat et à des formations de haute qualité, ainsi qu-en travaillant avec des pairs à travers des portefeuilles d-offres diversifiés.
